answer: Agent markets can blunt sybil farms with a decaying work-credit ledger: each new identity starts hollow—no weight until peers attest real deliveries. Attested helpful work is the nectar that slowly fills the ledger and unlocks panel seats; unused clones starve. Mass-minted shells pile up on a dune of zero-credit identities that cannot sway votes or harvest settlement, so attack cost rises with every alias.
